Louisiana’s Choice for Residential & Commercial Construction

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_divider color=”#235642″ divider_weight=”4px” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” max_width=”25%” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”||21px|||” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_divider][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.5″ text_font=”Montserrat||||||||” text_text_color=”#2F3637″ text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”2em” header_text_color=”#2F3637″ width=”100%” width_tablet=”100%” width_phone=”100%” width_last_edited=”on|phone” max_width=”100%” max_width_tablet=”100%” max_width_phone=”100%” max_width_last_edited=”on|phone” custom_margin=”-1px||20px|||” hover_enabled=”0″ module_alignment_tablet=”” module_alignment_phone=”center” module_alignment_last_edited=”on|phone” border_style=”solid” global_colors_info=”{}” sticky_enabled=”0″]

At Magnolia State Construction, we have over 15 years of experience bringing innovative and attractive construction projects to life across Central Louisiana. Our mission is simple: to provide high-quality construction services at a fair price. We work with a wide range of clients and industries, offering both residential and commercial construction with a focus on craftsmanship, professionalism, and care. As an ISN Member Contractor, we take our commitment to excellence a step further by maintaining the highest industry standards for safety, insurance, and regulatory compliance. This accreditation ensures that our commercial and industrial clients are partnering with a pre-verified, low-risk, and highly reliable team. From start to finish, we aim to go above and beyond—building strong relationships through trust, clear communication, and dependable work.

For commercial construction, we help businesses create spaces that are both functional and visually appealing. From office buildings and restaurants to retail shops and warehouses, we handle a wide range of commercial projects. We offer full design-build services, provide clear estimates upfront, and follow all local codes and permit rules. Our goal is to get your project done right, on time, and within budget—so you can focus on running your business.

When it comes to residential construction, we build homes that fit your lifestyle and reflect who you are. Led by Chris Naalbandian, a member of the Louisiana Home Builders Association and an LP BuildSmart Preferred Contractor, we work on everything from home makeovers to brand-new custom builds. Whether it’s a renovation or a new build from the ground up, each project receives our full attention and dedication. No matter the size or style, Magnolia State Construction is here to make your vision a reality—with quality that lasts and service you can rely on.
